name: Maldon

licensing.additional: No additional HMO licensing scheme: only the national mandatory licence for HMOs let to five or more people from more than one household who share facilities.

councilTax.text: £2,328.37 average Band D (2026/27), including Essex County Council, police, fire and average parish precepts

neighbourhoods.name: Maldon town
neighbourhoods.housing: Georgian and Victorian houses on the High Street and the Hythe, with post-war and modern estates around them.

neighbourhoods.name: Heybridge
neighbourhoods.housing: Victorian workers' terraces, post-war estates and new-build homes by the canal basin.

neighbourhoods.name: Burnham-on-Crouch
neighbourhoods.housing: Weatherboarded and Georgian houses on the quay, with later estates inland.

neighbourhoods.name: Southminster
neighbourhoods.housing: A Dengie village of older cottages and post-war and newer estates near the station.

neighbourhoods.name: Tollesbury
neighbourhoods.housing: Weatherboarded cottages near the marshes and marina, and post-war houses.

neighbourhoods.name: Mayland and Althorne
neighbourhoods.housing: Bungalows and chalet houses from the inter-war plotland era, with newer homes.

neighbourhoods.name: Danbury
neighbourhoods.housing: A wooded commuter village of detached houses and older cottages near Chelmsford.

neighbourhoods.name: Tiptree (Tolleshunt area)
neighbourhoods.housing: Village houses and bungalows on the district's northern edge.

housing: Maldon is a rural and estuary district, with the historic town of Maldon and Heybridge at its centre and the Dengie peninsula to the south-east. Most homes are owner-occupied, and lets are mainly period houses in Maldon, estate houses in Heybridge and bungalows in the villages. Many coastal and marshland homes are low-lying and some rural properties are off mains gas.
checkinTips: Low-lying homes near the Blackwater and Crouch estuaries: photograph floors, skirting and walls for damp or flood marks.
Weatherboarded cottages in Burnham, Tollesbury and Maldon: record the state of the boards, paint and window sills.
Bungalows and chalet houses in Mayland and Althorne: photograph roof spaces where reachable, gutters and any condensation.
Rural homes off mains gas: photograph the oil tank or LPG bottles, gauge levels and the boiler service label.
Older listed buildings in Maldon High Street: record beams, fireplaces, uneven floors and sash windows.
tenantHelp: Tenants with disrepair or safety concerns can contact Maldon District Council's environmental health team, which deals with private housing standards and HMO licences.
